versions.text:
[(a) Each item of installed equipment required by this chapter or otherwise essential to safe operation must--
  (1) Adequately perform its intended function under all probable operating conditions.]
  (2) If appropriate, be labeled as to its identification, function, or operating limitations, or any applicable combination of these factors;
  (3) Be installed according to limitations prescribed for that equipment and in compliance with Sec. 23.1431; and
  (4) Function properly when installed.
(b) Whenever necessary, additional equipment that is installed as prescribed in the operating rules of this chapter, must meet the requirements of this section.

actions.notes:
Notice of Airworthiness Review Program No. 2; Notice No. 75-10; Issued on 02/27/75.
	Notice of Airworthiness Review Program No. 5; Notice No. 75-23; Issued on 05/19/75.

Each item of installed equipment must--
(a) Be of a kind and design appropriate to its intended function;
(b) Be labeled as to its identification, function, or operating limitations, or any applicable combination of these factors; and
(c) Be installed according to limitations specified for that equipment.
